summary: Tested Prompts 2-9 batch on Morris SaaS. Backend pytest 6/6 passing (admin signup notification wired & non-crashing, /api/vision/extract auth-gated and reachable, /api/billing/status unlimited for admin, /api/auth/me, /api/generate variation-letter regression with autosave to Vault). Frontend UI verified: all 4 enhanced tool pages (toolbox-talk, coshh, hire-agreement, hs-policy) render their expanded field sets; Earnings/VAT/TaxPot/CompanyChecker/OfflineMode pages all render with their data-testids; Breadcrumbs appear on every /app/* page and are correctly hidden on /app root; Cmd+K command palette opens with cmdk-input; OnboardingTour modal shows on first session and skip dismisses it; PhotoToDocument auto-fires /api/vision/extract on file upload (verified via network intercept).

minor.issue: Returns 500 when Anthropic vision rejects malformed/tiny images (e.g. 1x1 PNG) — frontend handles this via a toast 'Could not read the photo automatically'. Consider returning a 422 with a friendly message instead of a 500, and logging the LLM error at WARNING not ERROR.

Login response does not include isAdmin / isUnlimited flags on the user object — only /api/auth/me computes them. Not breaking, but the frontend has to make a second call after login to know if the user is admin.

issues: Cookies consent banner overlaps the bottom of the page even after onboarding is dismissed — not blocking but should auto-hide once accepted via localStorage.

action_items: Optional: convert /api/vision/extract 500s on malformed image into a 422 with a friendly JSON error
Optional: include isAdmin/isUnlimited in /api/auth/login response so the frontend doesn't need a second /auth/me round-trip

ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL is wired but currently MOCKED — Resend send falls back to email_helper logger. Confirmed [MOCK EMAIL] To=hello@morrisapp.co.uk Subject=[Morris] New signup: ... is fired on each signup. To send real emails, set RESEND_API_KEY in backend/.env (this is expected per task note).
critical_code_review_comments: send_admin_signup is wrapped in a try/except — confirmed signup never crashes even when Resend is unreachable.

tools-config.js: confirmed expanded fields for toolbox-talk (topic, talkDate, siteName, deliveredBy, durationMinutes, attendeesCount, attendeesNames, specificHazards, ppeRequired, ppeOther), coshh (substance, manufacturer, location, activity, hazardClass dropdown, exposureRoute dropdown, wel, personsAtRisk, controlMeasures, ppeRequired, firstAid, storage, spillProcedure, rpeRequired dropdown), hire-agreement (hirerName, rateBasis, equipment etc.), hs-policy (companyTradingName, directorName, employersLiability etc.). All present in the rendered form.
Breadcrumbs correctly conditionally hidden on /app root via AppShell.
OnboardingTour respects localStorage flag 'morris_onboarding_done_v1' and persists dismissal.

success_rate.frontend: 100% page loads, all targeted testids present, all wired flows fire

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Prompts 2-9 deliverables verified end-to-end. Real-image OCR via /api/vision/extract requires a valid photo (Anthropic vision rejected a 1x1 fake PNG with 'Could not process image' which surfaces as a 500). The endpoint is correctly wired & auth-gated. Resend admin emails are MOCKED — RESEND_API_KEY is empty in backend/.env which is expected. Login response (/api/auth/login) does NOT include isAdmin/isUnlimited — they are only on /api/auth/me.
rca of the issue: PhotoToDocument 500 RCA: backend route /api/vision/extract passes image bytes to emergentintegrations LlmChat with claude-sonnet-4-5; Anthropic returns 'invalid_request_error: Could not process image' for the 1x1 PNG. This bubbles up as ChatError -> HTTPException 500. With a real construction photo the call will succeed. Suggested fix: catch ChatError in vision_extract and return HTTPException(status_code=422, detail='Image could not be processed — please try a clearer photo').
